items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: Now you take like Si E Si, play the drum with us. Two jobs in Santa Cruz.

ctx.x: That's right. When you say the band get together, you know when you say the band gets together. Yeah. What's the difference from you, from playing the trumpet, what's the difference between a band behind you that's not together? What's the main difference? Does it make you play any different? No. Or do you just try and play it the same way? No, no, no, no, no, no, no.

It don't make you play different. You see, look, you take a fellow, all right, you take a fellow in your band, you don't care how good he can play. When he get in your band he can't play nothing. You know what I mean? Because he got to sit there and get the understanding, the style you play, you know what I mean, everything, before he can get loose, you know what I mean? Do something. That's how it is. You know what I mean? No care how good a fellow can play when he get in your band. He can't play nothing. No,…
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
